results.headline: Operations Update
results.key_quote: With all engineering works complete at Hussar, drilling this prospect, along with completing the Mt Winter acquisition, remain our highest priorities.
results.summary: Georgina Energy provided an operations update on its Hussar and Mt Winter projects in Australia. The update details progress on civil engineering at Hussar (water well completed, airstrip ready, access roads prepared) and developments at Mt Winter (ALRA terms agreed, acquisition settlement underway, seismic program started). The company faces weather-related access restrictions but remains focused on drilling Hussar and completing the Mt Winter acquisition. No comparison to market expectations, guidance, or forecasts is provided in the announcement.

results.headline: Q3 trading update
results.key_quote: Lower Q3 revenue reflected reduced OTC revenue retention in less supportive market conditions, and I remain confident in meeting our medium-term guidance.
results.summary: Q3 2026 revenue of £240m down 14% year-on-year due to lower OTC revenue retention (70% vs 80% average). 2026 full-year revenue growth guidance lowered to mid-single-digit range. While organic first trades up 25% and active customers up 17%, and Underdog revenue up over 100%, the material decline in OTC revenue retention and full-year guidance reduction indicate results are below expectations. Positive elements (customer growth, Underdog performance) are outweighed by the significant revenue miss and guidance downgrade.
metrics_ahead: organic first trades up over 25% year-on-year
Underdog net revenue up over 100% year-on-year

results.headline: Preliminary Results
results.key_quote: At this early stage, we continue to anticipate profit before tax and separately disclosed items in line with current market expectations
results.summary: Wetherspoon reported FY2026 results with mixed financial performance. Revenue grew 5.2% to £2,238m and like-for-like sales increased 4.2%, demonstrating operational progress. However, profit before tax declined 28.0% to £58.6m (or -13.0% after separately disclosed items at £77.7m) and EPS fell 16.6% to 42.4p, reflecting industry headwinds from government tax and regulatory cost increases. The company explicitly stated it 'continues to anticipate profit before tax and separately disclosed items in line with current market expectations' for FY2027 (consensus £74m). The Chairman noted strong recent trading (8.6% LFL sales growth in last 9 weeks) and 48 consecutive months of outperforming the hospitality industry tracker, but cautioned this is partially weather-dependent. No guidance upgrade or downgrade was issued; management maintained expectations aligned with the market consensus.

results.headline: Q3 Portfolio Update
results.key_quote: We had expected Q3 to deliver the strongest quarterly NAV performance for at least 18 months, if not three years. It is unfortunate and regrettable that the developments at Cubo will mitigate the positive developments in other portfolio companies.
results.summary: Portfolio companies showed positive momentum with RCI completing acquisitions ahead of plan, Techpoint completing a significant acquisition, and Red Sky continuing strong performance. However, this was significantly offset by unexpected issues at Cubo Work, with the holding being written down to zero. Management states total NAV is not expected to fall below £270 million (less than 5% decline), but the Cubo write-down mitigates what would have been the strongest quarterly performance in at least 18-36 months. Mixed results: portfolio ahead of expectations offset by a material disappointment.
metrics_ahead: RCI acquisition trading ahead of plan
Red Sky strong sales wins and organic growth
Techpoint bolt-on acquisition completed without additional BOOK investment

results.company: Value and Indexed Property Income Trust
results.headline: Portfolio Update and Half Year Portfolio Valuation
results.key_quote: Both these total returns will be ahead of VIP's performance benchmark, the MSCI UK Quarterly Property Index.
results.summary: VIP reported portfolio performance exceeding its benchmark. Over six months to 30 September 2026, the portfolio delivered total returns of 3.8% (income 3.6%, capital gain 0.2%), which the company states will be ahead of the MSCI UK Quarterly Property Index benchmark. Quarterly total return was 1.8% driven by income. Portfolio value increased from £138.4m to £143.65m, with WAULT improved to 14.3 years. Three new properties acquired at 7.8% net initial yield. No explicit quantified expectation or guidance comparison provided, but the statement that results "will be ahead of" the benchmark constitutes performance ahead of expectations.

results.headline: ASX secondary listing+updated marketing guidance
results.key_quote: We now expect full-year 2026 Marketing Adj. EBIT to exceed $5bn.
results.summary: Glencore has updated its long-term Marketing Adjusted EBIT guidance methodology to reflect materially higher Readily Marketable Inventories (RMI) and current interest rate environment. The new long-term guidance mid-point is c.$3.5bn (range c.$2.8bn to c.$4.2bn) for application from 2027. For 2026, the company now expects full-year Marketing Adj. EBIT to exceed $5bn, up from the prior mathematical expectation of c.$4.9bn, driven by near-record H1 marketing performance and assuming H2 results towards the top end of previous guidance range. This represents performance ahead of the previous $2.3bn-$3.5bn guidance range.
metrics_ahead: Full-year 2026 Marketing Adjusted EBIT expected to exceed $5bn
H1 2026 marketing performance near record levels
H2 result expected towards top end of previous guidance range

results.headline: Unaudited Half Year Results 2026
results.key_quote: The Company is travelling through turbulence with regard to the Villeta Project...ATOME has served a Notice of Dispute and Intent to Submit a Claim to Arbitration under the UK-Paraguay Bilateral Investment Treaty 1981
results.summary: ATOME reported a significant loss of US$12.2 million in H1 2026 compared to US$3.1 million in H1 2025, representing a material deterioration. Despite having declared FID on the flagship Villeta Project in May 2026 with major financing and offtake agreements, the company subsequently faced major project disruption. Post-period events reveal Paraguay revoked the relevant Decree relating to the Power Purchase Agreement, prompting the company to serve notice of arbitration. While management expresses optimism about pursuing claims and progressing other projects, the announcement clearly indicates the company is 'travelling through turbulence' with its core project facing substantial regulatory/political setbacks. No explicit comparison to market or analyst expectations is stated, but the combination of significantly higher losses and post-period project disruption indicates performance below what would have been expected given the May 2026 FID announcement.
